# Setup script

This part contains connection function and necessary packages used in the notebook. If this becomes to exhaustive, it can be added to a separate script.

```{r}
library(inbolims)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(giscoR)
library(n2khab)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
veldwerk_connect <- function(dbname) {
  # Read credentials from environment variables (.Renviron)
  host <- Sys.getenv("VELDWERK_HOST")
  port <- Sys.getenv("VELDWERK_PORT")
  user <- Sys.getenv("VELDWERK_USER")
  pass <- Sys.getenv("VELDWERK_PASS")
  
  # Check to ensure credentials are set
  if (host == "" || user == "" || pass == "") {
    stop("Database credentials are missing. Check your .Renviron file.")
  }
  
  DBI::dbConnect(
    drv      = RPostgres::Postgres(),
    dbname   = dbname,
    host     = host,
    port     = port,
    user     = user,
    password = pass
  )
}
```

# Database connections

```{r}
con_gw <- veldwerk_connect("mnmgwdb")
con_surf <- veldwerk_connect("mnmsurfdb")
con_le <- veldwerk_connect("loceval")
con_lims <- lims_connect()
```

# Input Data

## Locevals

le_fieldwork

```{sql}
--| connection: con_le
--| output.var: le_fieldwork

WITH BASE AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_AsText(LOC.wkb_geometry) AS wkb_geometry
    , LOC.grts_address
    , LOC.location_id
    , SU.sampleunit_id
    , V.date_start
    , V.date_visit
    , V.type
    , V.type_assessed
    , V.notes
    , V.issues
    , V.visit_done
    , SU.is_replaced
    , SU.type_is_absent
    , R.grts_address_replacement
    , R.is_selected
    , unnest(string_to_array(SU.schemes, '|')) AS scheme
    , 1 as loceval
    , CASE
        WHEN V.issues THEN 0
        WHEN SU.type_is_absent THEN  0
        ELSE 1
      END AS loceval_approved
  FROM "metadata"."Locations" LOC
  INNER JOIN "inbound"."Visits" V
  ON LOC.location_id = V.location_id AND LOC.grts_address = V.grts_address
  INNER JOIN "outbound"."SampleUnits" SU
  ON V.sampleunit_id = SU.sampleunit_id
  LEFT JOIN "outbound"."Replacements" R
  ON SU.replacement_id = R.replacement_id
  INNER JOIN "metadata"."GroupedActivities" GA
  ON V.activity_group_id = GA.activity_group_id
  WHERE V.visit_done
  AND GA.activity_group LIKE 'LOCEVAL%'
)

SELECT * 
FROM BASE
WHERE scheme IN ('GW_03.3', 'SOIL_03.2', 'SURF_03.4_lentic')
-- AND (date_visit IS NULL OR date_visit <  '2026-09-26')
```

## Groundwater

gw_fieldwork

```{sql}
--| connection: con_gw
--| output.var: gw_fieldwork

WITH sampling_visits AS  (
  SELECT 
  SV.location_id
  , SV.sampleunit_id
  , SV.visit_done
  , SV.date_visit
  , SV.project_code
  , CASE 
  WHEN SV.recipient_code = '26-08679' THEN '26-008679' 
  ELSE SV.recipient_code 
  END as recipient_code
  FROM  "inbound"."SamplingVisits" SV
  INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" FC
  ON SV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
  WHERE NOT SV.issues
  AND SV.visit_done
  AND NOT FC.excluded
  -- AND (SV.date_visit IS NULL OR SV.date_visit <  '2026-09-26')
)

SELECT 
ST_AsText(LOC.wkb_geometry) AS wkb_geometry
, LOC.location_id
, LOC.grts_address
, IV.stratum
, IV.sampleunit_id
, IV.date_visit as installation_date
, SV.date_visit as sampling_date
, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(SV.visit_done as INT)), 0) as nr_visits
, TRUE AS is_installed
, COALESCE(BOOL_OR(SV.visit_done), FALSE) AS is_sampled
, IV.watina_code_used_1_peilbuis
, IV.watina_code_used_2_piezometer
, SV.project_code
, SV.recipient_code
FROM "metadata"."Locations" LOC
INNER JOIN "inbound"."InstallationVisits" IV
ON LOC.location_id = IV.location_id AND LOC.grts_address = IV.grts_address
INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" FC
ON IV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
LEFT JOIN sampling_visits SV
ON IV.location_id = SV.location_id AND IV.sampleunit_id = SV.sampleunit_id
WHERE NOT IV.issues
AND IV.visit_done
AND NOT FC.excluded
-- AND (IV.date_visit IS NULL OR IV.date_visit <  '2026-09-26')
GROUP BY 
LOC.wkb_geometry
, LOC.location_id
, LOC.grts_address
, IV.stratum
, IV.sampleunit_id
, IV.date_visit
, SV.date_visit
, IV.watina_code_used_1_peilbuis
, IV.watina_code_used_2_piezometer
, SV.project_code
, SV.recipient_code
ORDER BY is_sampled
```

gw_types

```{sql}
--| connection: con_gw
--| output.var: gw_types

SELECT DISTINCT stratum, type, main_type
FROM "metadata"."N2kHabStrata"
```

gw_domains

```{sql}
--| connection: con_gw
--| output.var: gw_domains

SELECT 
    DISTINCT grts_address, domain_part,
    CASE 
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2100015' THEN 'Kalmthoutse Heide'
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2100024' THEN 'Turnhouts Vennengebied'
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2200028' THEN 'Mechelse Heide'
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2200035' THEN 'Voerstreek'
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2200039' THEN 'De Maten'
        WHEN domain_part = 'Flanders_remainder' THEN 'Overig Vlaanderen'
        WHEN domain_part = 'SAC_network_remainder' THEN 'Overig SBZ-H'
        ELSE domain_part
    END AS domain_name
FROM "outbound"."SampleUnits"
WHERE schemes = 'GW_03.3'
AND domain_part IS NOT NULL
```

## Surface water

surf_fieldwork

```{sql}
--| connection: con_surf
--| output.var: surf_fieldwork

SELECT 
  ST_AsText(LOC.wkb_geometry) AS wkb_geometry
  , LOC.grts_address
  , LV.sampleunit_id
  , LV.stratum
  , LV.date_start
  , LV.date_visit
  --, LV.log_user -- GDPR: remove personal information
  , LV.notes
  , sampling_done
FROM "metadata"."Locations" LOC
INNER JOIN "inbound"."VisitsUnnested" LV
ON LOC.location_id = LV.location_id AND LOC.grts_address = LV.grts_address
INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" FC
ON LV.visit_id = FC.visit_id AND LV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
WHERE NOT LV.issues
AND LV.visit_done
AND NOT FC.excluded
-- AND (LV.date_visit IS NULL OR LV.date_visit <  '2026-09-26')
ORDER BY grts_address, stratum
```

## Lims

lims_sampleresults

```{sql}
--| connection: con_lims
--| output.var: lims_sampleresults

WITH RankedResults AS (
    SELECT 
      r.Project
      , s.LabSampleID
      , r.Customer
      , s.FieldSampleID
      , s.FieldSamplingDate
      --, s.FieldObserver -- GDPR: remove personal information
      , r.Component
      , u.Unit
      , r.Result as OriginalResult
      , TRY_CAST(REPLACE(r.Result, ',', '.') AS FLOAT) AS Result
      , CASE
          WHEN r.Component = 'NH4' THEN 0.776
          WHEN r.Component = 'NO3' THEN 0.226
          WHEN r.Component = 'PO4' THEN 0.326
          ELSE 1.0
        END AS ConversionFactor
      , r.isBelowLOQ
      , cmp.LOQ
      , CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(cmp.LOQ, '<', ''), ' ', ''), ',', '.') AS FLOAT) AS LOQValue
      , s.SampleStatus
      , r.ResultStatus
      , p.ProjectStatus
      , s.SampleType
      , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY r.Project, s.LabSampleID, r.Component
          ORDER BY 
              p.ProjectStatus DESC,   -- MIN ProjectStatus (bijv. 'V' boven 'C')
              s.SampleStatus ASC,  -- MAX SampleStatus (bijv. 'A' boven 'C')
              r.ResultStatus ASC   -- MAX ResultStatus (bijv. 'A' boven 'E')
        ) AS rn
    FROM dimSample s 
    LEFT JOIN factResult r ON r.SampleKey = s.SampleKey 
    INNER JOIN dimProject p ON r.ProjectKey = p.ProjectKey 
    INNER JOIN dimComponent cmp ON r.ComponentKey = cmp.ComponentKey 
    INNER JOIN dimUnit u ON r.UnitKey = u.UnitKey 
    WHERE (r.Project LIKE 'V-25W016%' OR r.Project LIKE 'V-26W012%')
      --AND r.ResultStatus != 'X'
      AND r.Component IN ('NH4', 'NO3', 'PO4', 'SO4')
      AND (s.SampleType IS NULL OR s.SampleType in ('Project'))
      AND r.IsReportable = 1
)
SELECT 
  Project as project_code_lims
  , LabSampleID as recipient_code
  , Component
  --, rn
  , CASE
      WHEN Component = 'NH4' THEN 'N-NH4'
      WHEN Component = 'NO3' THEN 'N-NO3'
      WHEN Component = 'PO4' THEN 'P-PO4'
      ELSE Component
    END as chem_variable
  , ProjectStatus
  , SampleStatus
  , ResultStatus
  , Customer
  , FieldSampleID
  , FieldSamplingDate
  --, FieldObserver
  , Unit as unit
  , OriginalResult
  , Result
  , CASE 
      WHEN isBelowLOQ = 1 
      THEN LOQValue 
      ELSE Result 
    END * ConversionFactor AS value
  , isBelowLOQ
  , LOQ
  , LOQValue
  , 'available' as in_lims
FROM RankedResults
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY Project, LabSampleID, Component
```

## Gisco

vlaanderen_provincies

```{r}
vlaanderen_provincies <- gisco_get_nuts(
  country = "Belgium",
  nuts_level = 2,
  resolution = "01"
) %>%
  filter(NUTS_NAME %in% c(
    "Prov. Antwerpen"
    , "Prov. Limburg (BE)"
    , "Prov. Oost-Vlaanderen"
    , "Prov. Vlaams-Brabant"
    , "Prov. West-Vlaanderen"
  )) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 31370)
```

# Create snapshots

```{r}
snapshot_dir <- here::here(
  "data", "snapshots", "vora-pas-2026-09-26"
)
dir.create(snapshot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

snapshots <- list(
  le_fieldwork = le_fieldwork,
  gw_fieldwork = gw_fieldwork,
  gw_types = gw_types,
  gw_domains = gw_domains,
  surf_fieldwork = surf_fieldwork,
  lims_sampleresults = lims_sampleresults,
  rep_types = rep_types,
  rep_sbz = rep_sbz,
  vlaanderen_provincies = vlaanderen_provincies
)

for (name in names(snapshots)) {
  saveRDS(
    snapshots[[name]],
    file.path(snapshot_dir, paste0(name, ".rds")),
    version = 3
  )
}
```

# Snapshot field overview

```{r}
snapshot_files <- list.files(
  snapshot_dir,
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

snapshot_field_overview <- purrr::map_dfr(snapshot_files, function(path) {
  snapshot <- readRDS(path)

  tibble::tibble(
    dataset = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path)),
    field = names(snapshot)
  )
})

knitr::kable(
  snapshot_field_overview,
  caption = "Fields included in each saved data snapshot."
)
```
